Class RmiServerProxy

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.network.rmi.RmiServerProxy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerProxy, VirtualServer, RmiClientRemote, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServerProxy extends UnicastRemoteObject implements ServerProxy, RmiClientRemote
RMI proxy on the client side.

Inbound (server → client): the server calls RmiClientRemote methods directly on this object via the RMI thread pool; each call is forwarded synchronously to the ClientNetworkDispatcher.

Outbound (client → server): calls from the UI thread are enqueued into a BlockingQueue and drained by a dedicated worker thread, so the UI never blocks on a slow or unreachable server.

Keep-alive is handled by a dedicated ping thread that fires at a fixed interval regardless of outbound traffic, matching the design of SocketServerProxy.

  • Constructor Details

    • RmiServerProxy

      public RmiServerProxy(String host, int port, LobbyModel lobbyModel, ClientView clientView) throws RemoteException
      Creates an RMI proxy ready to be wired and connected.

      The outbound worker thread is started immediately; no connection is established until connect() is called.

      Parameters:
      host - the server hostname or IP address
      port - the RMI registry port
      lobbyModel - the lobby model that receives pre-game notifications
      clientView - the view used to signal connection-state changes
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the UnicastRemoteObject constructor fails

  • Method Details

    • setClientController

      public void setClientController(ClientController controller)
      Wires this proxy to the given ClientController and creates the ClientNetworkDispatcher that routes inbound server notifications to the appropriate client-side model.

      Must be called before ServerProxy.connect() so that inbound events are dispatched correctly as soon as the connection is live.

      Specified by:
      setClientController in interface ServerProxy
      Parameters:
      controller - the client controller that owns the active model

    • connect

      public void connect() throws Exception
      Establishes the physical connection to the server.

      For RMI, performs the registry lookup and exports this object as a remote stub. For Socket, opens the TCP connection and starts the reader and ping threads. Must be called after ServerProxy.setClientController(ClientController) and before any outbound request is issued.

      Specified by:
      connect in interface ServerProxy
      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection cannot be established

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect()
      Closes the connection and releases all associated resources (threads, sockets, RMI stubs).

      Implementations must set an intentional-disconnect flag so that background threads do not trigger an automatic reconnection attempt.

      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface ServerProxy
